name: scan-planner-reproduction
title: Integrate SCAN-Planner Foxy with Lite3 Physics Simulation
description: Port the pinned SCAN ROS 2 planner core to Foxy and validate a versioned TCP closed loop against a pinned Lite3 Isaac policy simulation on the 5070 Ti.
creator: sun
notes: V3 uses the pinned sensor-rig URDF with V12 model_149999 plus live MID-360-like and D435i-like simulated sensors. V4--V6 remain immutable human-change-requested evidence. V7 candidate03 remains immutable with human review pending. The procedural V8 candidate passed automated gates but Dr Sun rejected its hand-authored human representation on 2026-08-14; it is immutable negative evidence and will not be submitted. V8 R2 references NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.1 male_adult_police_04 and replays a deterministic official 101-joint Biped-retarget cache. A separate hidden 1.70 m x 0.30 m capsule owns collision, clearance, and both sensor targets. Dr Sun approved the animated visual preflight on 2026-08-15. The first full preflight exposed a preset-start race: odometry could trigger planning before the first occupancy update. The readiness fix passed 82 remote C++/ROS tests. No-contact preflight04, two identical-effective-input dry runs, and frozen review candidate01 passed with zero non-foot collision, positive human clearance, sensor-causal SCAN replans, goal stop, complete local evidence, recursive hash parity, and local acceptance replay. AC40--AC43 are satisfied; AC44 and final task completion remain blocked on Dr Sun's direct raw/overlay video decision. Immediate preview05 was rejected because its route penetrated Rock_1 and did not cause a later local plan. Causal preflights 01--03 are preserved negatives; causal preflight04 is the first bounded pass. Long review01 passed but was superseded for low clearance. Long reviews 02 and 03 passed on the same operational input; review03 adds complete endpoint-x input provenance and its 16.29 s local video is ready for Dr Sun's visual review. Native-voxel review now uses the actual SCAN raw/inflated PointCloud2 XYZ data, a true three-axis 1:1 perspective renderer, and locally archived rosbag/snapshots. The rejected 2-D projection prototype and collision negatives remain preserved. Two identical-input 15.2 s 3-D review runs passed with 0.704 m minimum human clearance and zero contact; AC45 remains human-owned. No training or real-robot work was authorized or performed.
